prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 4 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1306; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented for evaluation of a concussion sustained when another vehicle sideswiped their car during a lane change. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms, and the head and neck complaints are plausible for a collision of this type. Over four visits, care followed a typical course of concussion management, including symptom monitoring, cognitive and vestibular rest guidance, and graded return-to-activity instructions. Symptoms gradually improved and treatment tapered accordingly. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm the injury. The patient also reported a minor strain in the same region several years ago, which resolved completely without residual limitation. Billing records showing two similar charges entered on the same day are currently under review by the administrative team. Clinical follow-up is planned as needed.
